notes: The release names byted-wandb, which is unavailable on public PyPI; the public wandb API package is used without changing training source.
OpenCompass 0.5.4 requires NumPy below 2; PyArrow is pinned to 25.0.1 because the PyArrow 26 wheel requires NumPy 2 or newer.
The server was shared. Unrelated CARLA processes occupied approximately 1.4 to 2.4 GiB on the two devices during the resource probes.
Pinned VeOmni FSDP2 does not consume enable_fsdp_offload. The released FSDP1 offload path reduced GPU use but exhausted 62 GiB host RAM plus 4 GiB swap and was SIGKILLed.
